messages.subject: Tooltip/Popover on element within object
parts:
I have seen this question posted before with no answers.

Is it possible to put tooltips/popovers on specific elements within an object? For example, if I have a checkboxGroup of 100 different choices, how would I put a different tooltip on each of box instead of one tooltip for the whole checkboxGroupInput?

Obviously, I could create 100 different checkBoxes themselves, but this would create a mess in ui.R/server.R.

Thanks,
Logan
